en: A monochrome postcard featuring a detailed lithographic portrait of a 19th‑century nobleman in formal attire, wearing a decorated jacket with numerous medals and a high collar. Below the portrait is a small heraldic emblem with a coronet and scrolls, and beneath that is a handwritten-style caption identifying the person. Additional small printed text appears near the bottom of the portrait, likely naming the lithography house or artist.
